svg.desc: Half Moon Bay LOCATION Dammam, KSA CLIENT Municipality of Eastern Region, KSA COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2013 14 billion SAR DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Project Overview Located in Dammam, KSA, and commissioned by the Municipality of the Eastern Region, this 60,000 feddans project was completed in 2013 with an estimated construction value of 14 billion SAR. It reimagines the bay by integrating land and water to create a distinct identity for the area. Designed to offer a seamless connection between natural and built elements, it provides users with a joyful, immersive experience.
